title: 第28章 安水县城
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
四天后，秋风爽利。

    官道上，陆舟的队伍远远看到了一座城池。

    “王爷，到安水县了！”

    周川骑马来到马车旁，恭声道，言语间带着一丝轻松。

    安水县距离州城不过三日路程，到了这里，意味着他们离目的地不远了。

    车帘掀开，陆舟看向那城池轮廓，眸光微闪，沉声道：“既如此，那就进城看看。”

    云州五县，这安水县因临近州城，经济还算繁荣。

    他打算进城补给一番。

    毕竟队伍自茶城离开后，就一直没有停歇，如今再加上上百号流民，粮草已是见了底。

    而且，这些流民也不能一直跟着队伍颠簸。

    正好安水县离州城近，地界安稳，不如就在这里把他们安顿下来，给田给活，先扎下根再说。

    除此之外，陆舟还在惦记着工匠和募兵方面的事情。

    云州此前从未建国，自然也没有王府。

    自己初来乍到，若临时抱佛脚去找人，不被当地官员拿捏才怪。

    不如在安水县先把工匠物色好，到时候直接开工，省得看人脸色。

    想到这里，陆舟眸光微沉。

    云州官场那帮人，恐怕早就收到他赴任的风声了。

    一个失势的皇子，完全是送上门的软柿子。

    他们当中，估计有不少人正等着好好拿捏拿捏自己，以表忠心！

    与其等到了州城被人架在火上烤，不如先在安水县把脚跟站稳一些。

    得到命令，队伍当即朝着安水县赶去。

    很快，众人临近县城。

    城墙雄伟，守备森严，城门早已紧闭！

    见状，李雄奉命上前，仰头冲城头喊道：“云王殿下亲临，速速开门！”

    城头一阵骚动。

    片刻后，一个身影出现在城垛后。

    此人三十出头，浓眉大眼，身形高大，甲胄鲜亮。

    “云王？”那人往下瞟了一眼，嗤笑一声：“你说王爷就是王爷？”

    李雄眉头一皱。

    那人远眺一番，并未看到其他人影，眼珠子一转，又继续道：“最近山匪猖獗，专爱冒充官军。本王看你们倒像是一群山匪！”

    说罢，他挥了挥手。

    城门洞开，一队甲士鱼贯而出，迅速散开，将陆舟的队伍包围起来。

    刀枪林立，杀气腾腾。

    “大胆，此乃云王当面！”

    这时，周川也带人赶来，厉喝一声。

    他没想到，这云州的守军竟然如此肆无忌惮。

    张承岳掏了掏耳朵，不屑地“啧”了一声，根本没搭理周川，冲着左右挥了挥手：“还愣着干什么？动手啊！”

    甲士们迟疑了一下，开始向前逼近。

    周川和李雄对视一眼，同时上前一步，内力爆发。

    恐怖威势，轰然释放！

    那强大气息，让不少甲士脸色微变。
content_en:
Four days later, the autumn breeze was refreshing.

    On the official road, Lu Zhou's team saw a city in the distance.

    "Your Majesty, we have arrived in Anshui County!"

    Zhou Chuan rode up to the carriage and said respectfully, with a hint of relaxation in his words.

    Anshui County is only three days away from the state capital. Arriving here means that they are not far from their destination.

    The car curtain opened, Lu Zhou looked at the outline of the city, his eyes flashed slightly, and he said solemnly: "In that case, let's go into the city and have a look."

    There are five counties in Yunzhou. Anshui County is relatively prosperous because it is close to the city.

    He planned to go into the city to replenish supplies.

    After all, the team has not stopped since they left the tea city. Now with hundreds of refugees, food and grass are at the bottom.

    Moreover, these refugees cannot keep following the team.

    It just so happened that Anshui County was close to the city and the territory was stable. It would be better to settle them here, give them work in the fields, and take root first.

    In addition, Lu Zhou was still thinking about craftsmen and recruiting soldiers.

    Yunzhou had never established a state before, so naturally there was no royal palace.

    I had just arrived, and it would be strange if I didn't get picked up by the local officials if I was trying to find someone at the last minute.

    It is better to identify the craftsmen in Anshui County first and start work directly when the time comes, so as not to look at people's faces.

    Thinking of this, Lu Zhou's eyes darkened slightly.

    The people in Yunzhou's official circles may have already received news of his appointment.

    A prince who has lost power is completely a weakling.

    There are probably many of them who are waiting to have a good look at themselves to show their loyalty!

    Instead of waiting to be roasted on the fire in Zhoucheng, it is better to establish a firmer footing in Anshui County first.

    After receiving the order, the team immediately rushed towards Anshui County.

    Soon, everyone approached the county seat.

    The city walls are majestic and heavily guarded, and the city gates have long been closed!

    Seeing this, Li Xiong was ordered to step forward, raised his head and shouted towards the city: "His Royal Highness King Yun is here in person, please open the door quickly!"

    There was a commotion at the top of the city.

    After a while, a figure appeared behind the battlements.

    This man is in his early thirties, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, tall body and bright armor.

    "Prince Yun?" The man glanced down and sneered: "You said the prince is the prince?"

    Li Xiong frowned.

    The man looked far away and saw no other figures. He rolled his eyes and continued: "bandits have been rampant recently, and they like to pretend to be officers and soldiers. To me, you look like a group of bandits!"

    After that, he waved his hand.

    The city gate opened, and a group of soldiers filed out, quickly dispersed, and surrounded Lu Zhou's team.

    There are many swords and guns, full of murderous intent.

    "Bold, this is King Yun's face!"

    At this time, Zhou Chuan also came with people and gave a sharp shout.

    He didn't expect that the Yunzhou defenders would be so unscrupulous.

    Zhang Chengyue picked his ears and gave a disdainful "tsk". He ignored Zhou Chuan at all and waved his hands to the left and right: "Why are you still standing there? Take action!"

    The soldiers hesitated for a moment and began to move forward.

    Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong looked at each other, took a step forward at the same time, and their inner strength exploded.

    The terrifying power is suddenly released!

    That powerful aura caused the expressions of many soldiers to change slightly.
